The journey

The first living things

Life, angels and humankind

Every creature comes from water, angels carry God's messages, and the human being is honoured.

God made every creature from water, the crawling, the two-legged and the four-legged. He creates what He wills. He made the angels His messengers, winged in twos, threes and fours. And the human being is honoured above much of creation, carried over land and sea, and fed on good things.

﴿وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

Quran · An-Nur 24:45

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَـٰثَ وَرُبَـٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

[All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

Quran · Fatir 35:1

﴿وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:70

The same in the other books

Translation

“But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you. Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you. Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this, in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

You might ask

QuestionIf we are dust and water, why honour us?
AnswerThe verse names all the children of Adam, with no race or faith set apart. Human dignity here is a gift from God, not a prize we earn.Quran · Al-Isra 17:70
QuestionWho are the angels, and what do they do?
AnswerThe Quran calls them honoured servants who act by His command. They are created, as we are, and their whole work is to carry out what God commands.Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:26-27
QuestionWhy would a holy book mention how animals walk?
AnswerThe verse names what anyone can see: belly, two legs, four legs, all from water. It sets that variety before the reader as the work of One who creates what He wills.Quran · An-Nur 24:45

One Maker of every living thing, and one human family honoured by Him.
